name: Vector Calculus
strandNote: Not needed to be hired. Rounds out a maths degree; used in physics-style models.
description: Integrate along curves and over surfaces, and link them with Green, Stokes and the divergence theorem.

lessonObjectives.l1-vector-fields: Sketch a vector field and read it as a gradient where possible.
lessonObjectives.l2-line-integrals: Compute a line integral by parametrising the curve.
lessonObjectives.l3-work-done: Compute the work a field does along a path.
lessonObjectives.l4-conservative-fields: Test a field for a potential, and use it to make a line integral path-independent.
lessonObjectives.l5-divergence-and-curl: Compute the divergence and curl of a field and read what they measure.
lessonObjectives.l6-green: Turn a line integral around a closed curve into a double integral with Green’s theorem.
lessonObjectives.l7-area-from-a-boundary: Find an area from a line integral around its boundary.
lessonObjectives.l8-flux-across-a-curve: Compute the flux of a field across a curve, and link it to divergence.
lessonObjectives.l9-parametric-surfaces: Parametrise a surface and compute its area element.
lessonObjectives.l10-surface-integrals: Compute a surface integral and the flux of a field through a surface.
lessonObjectives.l11-divergence-theorem: Turn the flux out of a closed surface into a triple integral of the divergence.
lessonObjectives.l12-stokes: Turn a line integral around a boundary into a surface integral of the curl.
